BiblicalUsage: Ebron is a town in the territory of Asher, named once in the boundary list of Joshua, and it is not the same place as Hebron in Judah despite the similar name. It sits on the northern coast, and the Bible says nothing more about it than its place in the inheritance. The name means alliance, and it marks one small corner of the land God gave.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God keeps careful track of the places He gives, down to towns named only once. Nothing in His gift is forgotten, even when the record is short.
